stories.summary: Scaffold ES modules and extract state, routing, api from app.js
stories.description: Change the dashboard script tag to type="module", create static/app/state.js, routing.js, api.js with the foundational shared code, and update app/dashboard.py's HTML template. Manual smoke verification (no JS test suite). First story; depends on nothing cross-epic.
stories.agent_instructions:
Behavior-preserving refactor. [no-new-tests] — there is NO JavaScript unit-test suite; verification is MANUAL SMOKE only.

GOAL: Begin converting static/app.js (2,730 lines, one global file) into ES modules. This story:
1. Change the `<script src=...>` tag in app/dashboard.py's HTML template to `<script type="module" src=...>` so ES module import/export works.
2. Create `static/app/state.js` — export the shared state object. Importers read from this module instead of `window.state`. Export the state object and any state-init helpers.
3. Create `static/app/routing.js` — export the hash deep-linking functions (route parsing, hashchange handling).
4. Create `static/app/api.js` — export `fetchJson`/`postJson` and any HTTP helper functions.
5. Update `static/app.js` to import from these new modules and remove the relocated code. Keep app.js as the entry point (the script tag can point at app.js, which imports the rest).

APPROACH: Move function bodies VERBATIM into the new modules — do NOT rewrite them. Every cross-function reference that today relies on global scope becomes an explicit `import`. Use named exports. The import graph must be acyclic at this layer (state/routing/api are foundational with no inbound deps from later render modules yet).

Do NOT change behavior or rewrite function bodies — only relocate functions into modules and add the import/export wiring.

MONKEYPATCH/EQUIVALENT HAZARD: any code that reads `window.state` directly must now import from `static/app/state.js`. Keep a `window.state` reference pointing at the exported state object for backward compat ONLY if some code still reads `window.state` after this story; otherwise remove it. Prefer having all readers import from the module.

VERIFICATION (MANUAL SMOKE — no JS test suite): load the dashboard in a browser, confirm it loads with NO console errors, the board renders, plan list/detail render, story modal opens, overview renders, comms/chat works, notifications/decisions panels render, polling continues. Set risk=medium because there is no automated safety net. Confirm `wc -l static/app.js static/app/state.js static/app/routing.js static/app/api.js` and that each new file is <1,000 lines (each should be small here). Do NOT edit any existing test file.
